svg.title: Editable reconstruction of FigFox-Gen V2 architecture
svg.desc: Native SVG text, geometry, arrows, charts and groups; only four local street photographs are embedded source crops. Faithful source reconstruction, including its ambiguous parallel-branch arrow.
svg.text: FigFox-Gen V2: From Methodology to Scientific Figure
